rounds.title: 曲目 1
rounds.prompt: Japanese instrumental chamber lo-fi with a clear one-minute arc. Begin with a four-bar koto and warm-piano introduction; state a memorable shamisen theme over restrained brushed drums; move to a contrasting shakuhachi-led middle with lighter texture and new harmony; return to the shamisen theme in a higher register and finish on a deliberate resolved cadence. Intimate, melodic, natural acoustic timbres, no vocals or speech.

rounds.title: 曲目 2
rounds.prompt: Melodic Japanese instrumental lo-fi shaped as four distinct sections. A short felt-piano and koto introduction leads to a singable shamisen theme with soft boom-bap pulse; the drums then drop out for a spacious shakuhachi response and harmonic turn; rhythm returns with a developed variation of the opening theme; close with a calm complete cadence. Warm, focused, expressive, no vocals, speech, rain recordings or drone.

rounds.title: 曲目 3
rounds.prompt: Bright Japanese instrumental lo-fi with audible sectional contrast. Open sparsely with koto arpeggios and Rhodes; introduce an uplifting shamisen hook with relaxed drums and rounded bass; shift into a softer bridge led by shakuhachi and changed chords; build briefly, then reprise the exact shamisen hook with fuller koto answers and a clean final cadence. Airy, polished, clearly melodic, no vocals, speech, field recordings or abrupt cutoff.
